ctx.x: Roy Liberto, yeah, Roy Liberto. His group was over there. Incidentally, the other, Roy Liberto's group rode a float in the parade. They had some of the floats from the New Orleans Mardi Gras that was sent over there to go in this parade and Roy Liberto's group rode one of the floats. I don't know if Hector Fontana's band participated in the parade but they did some, you know, some of the extra parties and things like that. Our group, of course, had a march but all in all it was a real colorful parade. I think…
Did any of the other bands sound like jazz at all?
